simple.meaning: מִשְׁקָל (mishqâl) is a Hebrew object word meaning “weight (numerically estimated); hence, weighing (the act).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 24:22. The surrounding context includes offering, righteousness, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִשְׁקָל (H4948) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
